blocks.text: sp3 hybridization mein ek s orbital (kam energy, kurrawi) aur teen p orbitals (zyada energy, dumb-bell shakal) mil kar ek jaisi energy aur shakal ke chaar orbitals ka naya set dete hain, har ek sp3 hybrid orbital, jo CH4 ki tarah tetrahedral geometry mein tarteeb pate hain. Carbon ground state mein 2s2 2px1 2py1 2pz1 hai; excited state mein ek 2s electron oopar jata hai, jo 2s1 2px1 2py1 2pz1 deta hai; phir chaar sab se bairooni orbitals chaar sp3 hybrids mein milte hain, har ek mein ek electron. Hybrid orbitals ki energies ghair-hybrid p orbitals se kam hain. Har sp3 hybrid ke do lobes hain, ek bara aur ek chhota; asani ke liye chhota lobe aam taur par nahi dikhaya jata. Barabar energy ke chaar hybrids ki tetrahedral geometry hai jis ke markaz mein carbon nucleus hai. Methane sp3 hybrids ke chaar hydrogen atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap se banta hai, sp3-s overlap se chaar sigma bonds jo ba-qaida tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain.

sp2 hybridization mein atom ke ek s aur do p orbitals mil kar teen sp2 hybrid orbitals banate hain. Teen aadhe bhare sp2 hybrids 120 degrees ke bond zawiyon ke saath trigonal planar geometry mein tarteeb pate hain. Yeh BF3 jaise musattah molecules ki geometry samjhata hai. Boron ground state mein 2s2 2px1 hai; excited ho kar 2s1 2px1 2py1; teen sab se bairooni orbitals mil kar teen sp2 hybrids dete hain, ek p orbital ghair-istemal reh jata hai. Fluorine ka ek p orbital aadha bhara hai (maslan 2pz), aur BF3 boron ke teen aadhe bhare sp2 hybrids ke teen fluorine atoms ke 2pz orbitals se overlap se banta hai; banawat trigonal planar hai jis ke bond zawiye 120 degrees hain.

sp hybridization mein ek s orbital (kam energy, kurrawi) aur ek p orbital (zyada energy, dumb-bell shakal) mil kar ek jaisi energy aur shakal ke do orbitals dete hain, sp hybrids, jo 180 degrees par khatti tarteeb mein hain. Beryllium ground state mein 2s2 hai; excited ho kar 2s1 2px1; dono mil kar do sp hybrids dete hain jo ek lakeer mein hain. Yeh beryllium chloride, BeCl2, jaise linear molecules ki geometry samjhata hai, jo beryllium ke do sp hybrids ke do chlorine atoms ke aadhe bhare p orbitals se overlap se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen pattiyan. Har ek mein ek atom ke valence shell ke ground, excited aur hybridized box diagrams sabz hybrid khanon ke saath, aur molecule ka chapta khaaka: carbon ke chaar sp3 lobes tetrahedron mein chaar hydrogens ko, boron ke teen sp2 lobes tikon mein teen fluorines ko, aur beryllium ke do sp lobes lakeer mein do chlorines ko. Ek khulasa dabba teen qismein deta hai.
blocks.caption: Carbon, boron aur beryllium ki sp3, sp2 aur sp hybridization (Figures 3.27 se 3.32 aur chhape hue box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Carbon ek 2s electron oopar bhejta hai, phir 2s ko teen 2p se mila kar chaar barabar sp3 hybrids banata hai jo 109.5 degrees par tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain; har ek hydrogen 1s se overlap kar ke methane banata hai. Boron 2s ko do 2p se mila kar plane mein 120 degrees par teen sp2 hybrids banata hai, ek p orbital khali chhor kar, aur BF3 mein teen fluorine 2p orbitals se bandhta hai. Beryllium 2s ko ek 2p se mila kar 180 degrees par do sp hybrids banata hai, do p orbitals chhor kar, aur BeCl2 mein do chlorine p orbitals se bandhta hai. Hybrids ki ek energy hai, s aur p ke darmiyan, aur hybrids ki tadaad mile hue orbitals ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: NH3 aur CO2 mein orbital hybridization aur har ek se banne wali shakal ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: NH3 mein nitrogen apne 2s aur teen 2p orbitals ko chaar sp3 hybrids mein milata hai; teen mein ek ek electron hai jo hydrogen 1s orbitals se overlap karte hain, chautha lone pair rakhta hai, to molecule 109.5 degrees se thora kam zawiyon wala trigonal pyramid hai. CO2 mein carbon apne 2s ko ek 2p se mila kar 180 degrees par do sp hybrids banata hai, jo do oxygens se sigma bonds banate hain, jabke us ke baqi do p orbitals double bonds ke pi bonds banate hain; molecule linear hai.

items: sp3: ek s + teen p, chaar hybrids, tetrahedral, 109.5 degrees (CH4 sp3-s overlap se); hybrids energy mein p se neeche hain aur bara aur chhota lobe rakhte hain.
sp2: ek s + do p, teen hybrids, trigonal planar, 120 degrees (BF3 sp2-p overlap se, ek p ghair-istemal). sp: ek s + ek p, do hybrids, linear, 180 degrees (BeCl2 sp-p overlap se).
